Transaction ABI structs and initialization logic for legacy and v0 messages, plus address lookup resolution.

# Purpose
This file defines the bank ABI for transaction data used by the runtime. It declares packed C types that match the in-memory layout of Solana transaction objects, including legacy messages, v0 messages, address table lookups, loaded addresses, and transaction-private metadata. The many `FD_STATIC_ASSERT` checks verify field offsets, sizes, and alignment so the C layout stays compatible with the expected ABI. The file also defines small option-like unions and helper types that encode values such as compute budget requests and transaction message variants.

The file also implements transaction initialization and address lookup resolution for the bank. The function [`fd_bank_abi_txn_init`](<#fd_bank_abi_txn_init>) builds an internal `fd_bank_abi_txn_t` from a parsed `fd_txn_t`, computes the message hash, records signature and instruction counts, parses compute budget instructions, and fills writable-account caches. It handles both legacy and v0 transactions, including address lookup table loading through [`fd_bank_abi_resolve_address_lookup_tables`](<#fd_bank_abi_resolve_address_lookup_tables>). The helper [`fd_bank_abi_get_lookup_addresses`](<#fd_bank_abi_get_lookup_addresses>) returns the loaded writable lookup addresses for v0 transactions.
